start_cursor.description: Optional pagination cursor (offset) from a previous call.

page_size.description: Maximum number of users to return (1-100, default 50).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a paginated list (object, results, next_cursor, has_more).

description: Get a single user by id.

user_id.description: The unique id of the user.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the user object; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get the current integration owner (first non-bot user).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the owner user object.

description: Get information about the current workspace.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the workspace object.

description: Search pages and databases by title, optionally filtered by object type.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to match against titles.

page_size.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 50).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a paginated list of matching pages/databases.

description: Get a single database by id.

database_id.description: The unique id of the database.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the database object; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Query the pages inside a database with optional status/assignee filters and sorting.

database_id.description: The unique id of the database to query.

filter_status.description: Optional Status property value to filter pages by.

filter_assignee.description: Optional Assignee (person) id to filter pages by.

page_size.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 50).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a paginated list of pages; on failure (database not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a single page by id, including its properties.

page_id.description: The unique id of the page.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the page object with properties; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new page under a database, page, or workspace parent.

parent_id.description: The id of the parent (database id, page id, or workspace id).

title.description: The title of the new page.

properties.description: Optional mapping of property name to value or {type, value}.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created page; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Update a page's title, archived state, or properties.

page_id.description: The unique id of the page to update.

properties.description: Optional mapping of property name to value or {type, value} to set/merge.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated page; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

page_id.description: The unique id of the page to delete.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the archived page; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the child blocks of a page or block.

block_id.description: The page id (for root blocks) or block id (for nested blocks).

page_size.description: Maximum number of blocks to return (1-100, default 50).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a paginated list of blocks.

description: Append new child blocks to a page or block.

block_id.description: The parent page id or block id to append to.

children.description: List of block objects to create (each with type, text, and optional checked).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has the list of created blocks; on failure (parent not found), output contains an error message.

description: Update a block's text and/or checked state.

block_id.description: The unique id of the block to update.

checked.description: Optional new checked state (only applied to to_do blocks).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated block; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

block_id.description: The unique id of the block to delete.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has object, id, and deleted; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: List comments, optionally filtered by block or page.

block_id.description: Optional block id to filter comments by.

page_id.description: Optional page id to filter comments by.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has a list of comments.

description: Create a comment on a page (optionally attached to a block).

parent_page_id.description: The id of the page the comment belongs to.

author_id.description: The id of the comment author.

parent_block_id.description: Optional block id the comment is attached to.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created comment; on failure (page not found), output contains an error message.
